queries.query: Rivne Ukraine official cadastral map public parcel map land records GIS
queries.result: Found the official StateGeoCadastre public cadastral-map documentation and the official Rivne municipal urban-planning GIS. The municipal portal identifies a land-parcel register and a cadastral-information map action; no anonymous parcel geometry response was obtained.

queries.query: Рівне офіційна кадастрова карта земельний кадастр геопортал земельні ділянки
queries.result: Found the official Rivne City Council urban-planning GIS (Геоінформаційна система Рівненської міської територіальної громади), its land-parcel register route, and the StateGeoCadastre public cadastral-map documentation. The municipal register page reports that the register is in the process of being populated; no parcel geometry was returned.

localCustodian.name: Department of Urban Planning and Architecture of the Executive Committee of Rivne City Council / Rivne municipal GIS
localCustodian.evidence: The live municipal portal identifies the governing body as the Rivne City Council urban-planning and architecture department, exposes a map action labelled cadastral land information, and links a land-parcel register. The register URL is public but currently displays 'Реєстр в процесі наповнення' (register in the process of being populated).

generalAgency.name: State Service of Ukraine for Geodesy, Cartography and Cadastre (StateGeoCadastre)
generalAgency.scope: National cadastral custodian and public cadastral-map documentation; treated as general national agency context, not as proof of a Rivne-specific anonymous API response.

parcelSource.layerName: Municipal cadastral land-information map action; exact backend layer endpoint not exposed in the inspected HTML/configuration
parcelSource.sourceCrs: Map configuration declares map SRID options including EPSG:4326 and local Ukrainian systems; no parcel-layer response was available to confirm the active parcel-layer CRS.

runtimeReadiness.reason: A real local municipal cadastral/map custodian was evidenced, but no bounded anonymous parcel response with safe native IDs and geometry was obtained. Runtime admission remains held pending independent serial adapter qualification.
